gloss: in the mountains; deep in the mountains

definitions.gloss: in the mountains; deep in the mountains
definitions.explanation: Inside a mountain area, away from towns. A written word, common in news reports about accidents, searches, and finds in the mountains.

examples.japanese: {山中|さんちゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迷|まよ}った→迷う：02426_mayou⟧。
examples.english: I got lost in the mountains.

examples.japanese: ⟦{行方不明|ゆくえふめい}→行方不明：14039_yukuefumei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{山中|さんちゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: The missing man was found in the mountains.

examples.japanese: {山中|さんちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ひっそり→ひっそり：10473_hissori⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{建|た}つ→建つ：12544_tatsu⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|たず}ねた→訪ねる：01182_tazuneru⟧。
examples.english: I visited an old temple standing quietly deep in the mountains.

notes:
In conversation, ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧ is more usual.

- {山中|さんちゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遭難|そうなん}→遭難：09510_sounan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to get into trouble in the mountains
